cv:
NADIA BRENNAN-AZIZ
Senior Site Reliability / Platform Engineer
Manchester, UK | nadia.brennanaziz@example.com | +44 7700 900909 | github.com/nba-sre-example

SUMMARY
Senior SRE / platform engineer with 10 years in infrastructure, the last 6 running Kubernetes platforms on AWS. I build paved roads for product teams: self-service infrastructure, sane defaults, good observability, and incident processes that people actually follow.

EXPERIENCE

Senior Platform Engineer - Tallybrook Ltd (B2B accounting SaaS), Manchester / remote       Apr 2022 - present
- Tech lead of the 5-person platform team; run the EKS platform (8 clusters, ~350 services, 3 regions).
- Built the internal developer platform: service templates, Argo CD GitOps, Crossplane-based self-service for RDS, SQS and S3; new service to production went from ~2 weeks to under 1 day.
- Introduced SLOs and error budgets for the 20 most critical services; on-call pages per week down ~60%.
- Moved node provisioning to Karpenter with spot instances; EC2 spend down 38%.
- Incident commander rotation; wrote the incident and post-mortem process.

Site Reliability Engineer - Brightwater Games, Leeds                                      Jan 2019 - Mar 2022
- Ran game backend infrastructure on AWS (EC2, ECS then EKS) for titles with up to 1.2M daily active players.
- Terraform for all AWS infrastructure (~40 modules); Atlantis for plan/apply on pull requests.
- Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager and Loki stack; replaced a noisy Nagios setup.
- Load testing with k6 before launches; launch-day capacity planning.

Linux Systems Engineer - Pennine Hosting, Sheffield                                      Jul 2016 - Dec 2018
- Managed ~600 Linux servers for hosting customers; Puppet configuration management.
- Automation in Bash and Python; on-call for customer incidents.

EDUCATION
BSc Computer Science, University of the North Moors, 2016

CERTIFICATIONS
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) - 2021, renewed 2024
AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional - 2023

SKILLS
AWS (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, S3, SQS, Route 53, CloudFront), Kubernetes, Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD, Crossplane, Karpenter, Terraform, Atlantis, Go, Python, Bash, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager, OpenTelemetry, k6, GitHub Actions, Puppet, Linux, SLOs/error budgets, incident management

LANGUAGES
English (native), Urdu (conversational)
cover_letter:
Dear Tallybrook hiring team,

I'm applying for the Senior Platform Engineer role.

At Brightwater Games I have spent three years keeping game backends up during launches with over a million daily players. I moved our infrastructure fully into Terraform with Atlantis, replaced our Nagios alerting with Prometheus and Alertmanager, and led capacity planning for two major launches. Those launches taught me that reliability is mostly about preparation and about making the safe path the easy one.

Your job ad talks about building a platform that product teams love to use. That is exactly the work I want to do next: fewer heroics, more paved roads. I hold the CKA certification and have run EKS in production since 2020.

I would love to tell you more about how I approach platform work.

Best wishes,
Nadia Brennan-Aziz
